reasoning_content:
The server started but curl returned 000 - maybe it was still starting or exited before curl? Log shows fetching. Let me check the full log and if the server listens. Maybe it needs DB. Let's run longer and check listening ports.

Actually curl ran at 12s; server was still fetching remote config. But http_code 000 means connection failed — maybe not yet listening. Let's do a longer test.

action.command: cd /workspace && (timeout 40 ./badge-api serve --port 8080 > /tmp/serve2.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 20); do sleep 2; code=$(curl -s --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8080/ 2>/dev/null); echo "t=$((i*2))s code=$code"; if [ "$code" != "000" ]; then break; fi; done; echo "=== tail log ==="; tail -20 /tmp/serve2.log

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && (timeout 40 ./badge-api serve --port 8080 > /tmp/serve2.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 20); do sleep 2; code=$(curl -s --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" http://localhost:8080/ 2>/dev/null); echo \"t=$((i*2))s code=$code\"; if [ \"$code\" != \"000\" ]; then break; fi; done; echo \"=== tail log ===\"; tail -20 /tmp/serve2.log", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Start server and poll until HTTP responds"}

summary: Start server and poll until HTTP responds
